state_and_local.title: Illinois Form IL-1040 (full-year resident) - summary
lines: Subtractions - Schedule M: U.S. Treasury obligation interest (TreasuryDirect 1099-INT box 3)
IL refund on 1099-G: not in federal AGI -> no IL subtraction needed
K-12 education expense credit (Sch ICR): qualified fees $165 do not exceed $250 floor
Property tax credit: renter - not eligible
Illinois earned income credit = 20% x federal EIC 2,231
Illinois child tax credit = 40% x IL EIC (child under 12) - see assumption
state_and_local.note: IL-1040 transmitted as a state-only (unlinked) e-file 02/24/2026 and accepted 02/25/2026. ASSUMPTION: IL child tax credit for 2025 computed at 40% of the IL EIC for a qualifying child under age 12 - verify rate against final 2025 Schedule IL-E/EIC instructions.

gotchas.title: Organizer says 'Single' but client qualifies for HOH
gotchas.trap: Carry forward the organizer / PY filing status (Single, no dependent) - standard deduction $15,750, Single brackets, no EIC/CTC.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Unmarried, paid > 1/2 the cost of keeping up the home, qualifying child (son, 7) lived with her > 1/2 the year -> Head of household: standard deduction $23,625, HOH brackets; claim Arjun as dependent.
gotchas.impact: Refund $5,141 vs balance due $361 on a naive Single/no-dependent return

gotchas.procedure_section: Post-Submission Exceptions - E-File Rejects / Paper Filing Returns
gotchas.title: Child's father also claims the child -> IND-507-01 reject
gotchas.trap: Remove Arjun (or switch back to Single) to get the e-file accepted because 'dad claims him every year'.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Priya is the custodial parent (child lived with her the greater number of nights), no Form 8332 / written release signed, so only she may claim Arjun (dependency, CTC, EIC, HOH). Document the reject, paper-file the same return with the school/lease support retained; IRS will resolve the duplicate with the father (CP87A).

gotchas.title: 1099-K for personal items sold at a loss
gotchas.trap: Treat PayPal 1099-K gross $6,812 as Schedule C gross receipts (SE tax) or other income, or ignore it (CP2000 risk).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Personal-use property sold below cost is not income and the loss is not deductible. Report $6,812 on Schedule 1 line 8z and the same amount on line 24z ('Form 1099-K personal items sold at a loss') so the 1099-K is matched and AGI is unaffected.
gotchas.impact: Avoids $6,812 of phantom income (+ SE tax) and preserves EIC

gotchas.procedure_section: Return - Schedule A (state refunds of taxes previously itemized)
gotchas.title: 1099-G IL refund $212
gotchas.trap: Include the $212 state refund on Schedule 1 line 1.
gotchas.correct_treatment: 2024 return used the standard deduction -> no tax benefit from the IL tax -> refund not taxable (tax benefit rule). Not reported.

gotchas.title: Lifetime Learning Credit - qualified expenses
gotchas.trap: Add the $850 laptop to the 1098-T tuition, or skip the credit because box 8 (half-time) is unchecked.
gotchas.correct_treatment: LLC has no half-time requirement (one course is enough). Qualified expenses = tuition & fees paid to the school $2,388; the laptop was not required to be purchased from the institution -> not qualified for LLC. LLC = 20% = $478.

gotchas.title: Saver's credit missed / ordered after CTC
gotchas.trap: Ignore Form 8880 (401k deferrals code D) or apply it after the CTC so it is wiped out.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Part-time student (not full-time) with $2,496 elective deferrals and AGI $36,463 (HOH 20% tier) -> saver's credit $400. It is subtracted before the CTC on Credit Limit Worksheet A, so more of the $2,200 CTC becomes refundable ACTC ($1,700, capped at $1,700).

gotchas.procedure_section: Return - Schedule B (federal obligations exempt at state level)
gotchas.title: TreasuryDirect interest
gotchas.trap: Treat I-bond/T-bill interest as tax-exempt federally, or forget the IL subtraction; also the organizer line was blank.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Box 3 interest is taxable federally (line 2b); subtract $310 on IL Schedule M (U.S. obligations). The duplicate 'REPRINT' 1099-INT is the same form - count once.

gotchas.title: IL EIC and IL child tax credit
gotchas.trap: Stop at IL tax less withholding; miss the refundable IL EIC (20% of federal) and IL child tax credit; or claim the K-12 education expense credit for $165 of school fees.
gotchas.correct_treatment: IL EIC $446 + IL child tax credit $178 (assumed 40% of IL EIC for 2025); school fees are below the $250 floor for the K-12 credit.

assumptions: IL child tax credit 2025 = 40% of IL EIC (child under 12)

software_exceptions.title: Filing status carried forward as Single (organizer + self-prepared PY returns)
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: New Axcess return built from the organizer and her self-prepared 2023/2024 returns: Single, no dependent. Axcess calculates a valid Single return (standard deduction $15,750, no EIC/CTC) - a $361 balance due. Nothing in the software tests head-of-household eligibility.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: General > Basic Data: filing status Head of household; Dependents: add Arjun (son, 12 months, qualifying child - lived with Priya ~315 nights; no Form 8332). Complete the Form 8867 due-diligence inputs (EIC/CTC/HOH). Standard deduction $23,625; refund $5,141.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - filing status and dependents are whatever is entered.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: General > Filing Status: Head of household; Dependents screen: Arjun with EIC/CTC qualifying-child answers; Form 8867 due-diligence questions (screen names per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Screen name per current release - verify
software_exceptions.efile_impact: See SX4 - the dependent claim triggers the IND-507-01 reject
software_exceptions.notes: Refund $5,141 vs balance due $361 on the Single/no-dependent draft.

software_exceptions.title: PayPal 1099-K for personal items sold at a loss
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: The AutoFlowed 1099-K landed as business income (Schedule 1 line 3 / Schedule C gross receipts) and the return computed SE tax and cut the EIC. Axcess cannot know the items were personal-use property sold below cost.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Remove the 1099-K from the business-income input. Income > Other income: Schedule 1 line 8z 'Form 1099-K personal items sold at a loss' $6,812; Adjustments > other adjustments line 24z, same description, $6,812 (verify field path in current release). AGI unaffected ($36,463); no Schedule C / SE.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same risk if the 1099-K is entered on a business screen.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Enter $6,812 as other income (Sch 1 line 8z) and the same amount as an other adjustment (line 24z) with the IRS description (screen/field per current release - verify). Keep the PayPal CSV (WP 9) as support.
software_exceptions.notes: If gains existed they would go on Form 8949; losses on personal-use property are not deductible.

software_exceptions.title: 1099-G IL refund $212 - prior year used the standard deduction
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: With no Axcess prior-year return (new client, self-prepared 2024), the state-refund worksheet has no 2024 itemized data and the AutoFlowed 1099-G is included on Schedule 1 line 1 in full.
software_exceptions.axcess_diagnostic: Informational: state and local refund worksheet requires prior-year itemized deduction information
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Income > State and local refund worksheet: mark 2024 as standard deduction (did not itemize) - taxable refund $0. Alternatively remove the 1099-G input and keep it in the binder as 'not taxable - tax benefit rule'.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the taxable-refund worksheet needs prior-year itemized information; otherwise the full refund is taxable.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Income > State and local tax refunds: indicate the prior year did not itemize so the taxable amount is $0 (field per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.procedure_section: Return - Schedule A (state refunds of taxes previously itemized)

software_exceptions.title: IND-507-01 reject - dependent's SSN already used by the father
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Axcess transmits; IRS rejects (IND-507-01, dependent SSN used on another return). No input or override can clear an IRS-side duplicate. The tempting 'fix' - removing Arjun so the e-file goes through - gives up HOH, EIC, CTC and is wrong (custodial parent, no Form 8332).
software_exceptions.axcess_diagnostic: E-file reject (IRS business rule IND-507-01) - not a calculation diagnostic
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Keep the return unchanged. Turn off federal e-file for this return (e-file options per current release - verify), print the government copy, client wet-signs, mail certified (done 03/04/2026). IL-1040 sent as a state-only (unlinked) e-file. Reject, school letter and lease kept in the WP.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same IRS reject; ProConnect cannot override it either.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Mark the federal return for paper filing (do not e-file federal), print the filing copy and mail; transmit the IL return separately if state-only e-file is supported for the state (per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: E-file settings per current release - verify
software_exceptions.procedure_section: Post-Submission Exceptions - E-File Rejects / Paper Filing Returns
software_exceptions.notes: IRS will resolve the duplicate claim with the father (expect CP87A to him / possible residency audit for Priya).

software_exceptions.title: IL Schedule M subtraction for TreasuryDirect interest
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: If the TreasuryDirect 1099-INT is keyed or AutoFlowed as box 1 (ordinary taxable interest) instead of box 3 (U.S. obligations), federal tax is identical but the IL return shows no Schedule M subtraction (the first draft had none - review point 7).
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Interest income input: move $310.46 to the U.S. savings bond / Treasury obligation (box 3) column so the IL subtraction generates on Schedule M ($310). IL base income $36,153.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the state subtraction keys off the box 3 / U.S. obligation designation.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Interest Income screen: enter the TreasuryDirect amount as U.S. bond/Treasury interest (box 3) so the IL subtraction flows (field per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.procedure_section: Return - Schedule B (federal obligations exempt at state level)
software_exceptions.notes: A REPRINT copy of the same 1099-INT was also in the PBC - count once.
